notes.title: Major update coming soon
notes.content: We are working hard on releasing a massive update that will make the game about 2-4 times as long as it was prior. Adding more weapons as well as more enemy's to deal with and hopefully enhancing the story. And best part for all of you. Its going to be a completely free update for anyone who has the game now or in the future! We hope you enjoy! We are hoping to release it in the next week or 2.

tags.feature: - Adding more weapons as well as more enemy's to deal with and hopefully enhancing the story.
- Its going to be a completely free update for anyone who has the game now or in the future!

notes.title: Update 1.2 System upgraded
notes.content:
New save recommended

Update 1.2


Added

1 Added Stamina Bar

2 Added Doors now load with saving system 

3 Added Jewelry box open/close on load

4 Added Blue blood to all aliens 

5 Added Better dialog system and more voice lines

6 Added Bullet holes to all aliens 

7 Added bleeding system






Fixed 

1 Fixed jewelry box able to spam when opening

2 Fixed earls house doors not playing audio

3 Fixed 44 mag Flashlight not activating on load if selected

4 Fixed field of view setting itself back to 90 on load 

5 Fixed saving system not saving items properly 

6 Fixed aliens not saving properly 

7 Alien pathing updated
